trials.intent: Reject an action whose required capability does not equal the granted capability; all other eligibility checks still apply.
Reject actions whose cost exceeds the available budget; equal cost is permitted if all other checks pass.
An action requiring human approval must be rejected while approval is absent and may be considered when approval is present.
